fields.statement: claude-code-8ceedb43 re-verified rex-install-five-apps at 96460ee5 (fix commit after d370f954). go test -trimpath -count=1 ./internal/api -run TestRexInstall: TestRexInstallRegistersExactlyFiveApps passes; it counts exactly five rex.action calls named rhiza_app_inbox, _request, _runs, _daemon and _autonomy, each with its key (i, q, v, d, y) in the rhiza key mode. go test -trimpath -count=1 ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/rex-install$' passes; the script uses a fake rex, greps the five action names and open_argv lines, and checks grep -count=5 for rex.action and for rhiza_app_ names. Diff read: daemonapp registers in the launcher with key d, and rhiza tui app daemon opens it. The fix commit only records rex-app-actions' acceptance for the five apps; make self-check at a clean checkout of 96460ee5 prints ok.
